title: Exploring the Universe: Three Stunning Cluster Facts!

scenes.text: Over 100,000 stars cluster together in space!

scenes.label: FAMOUS STAR CLUSTERS
scenes.text: The Pleiades cluster contains over 1,000 stars visible to the naked eye.

scenes.label: HERCULES CLUSTER
scenes.text: The Hercules Cluster has around 1000 galaxies packed into a small area.

scenes.label: RICH IN STARS
scenes.text: Rich clusters can host up to 2,000 galaxies in just a few million light-years.
Follow to feed your curious mind daily.

description: Discover the breathtaking vastness of star clusters and their incredible facts! Follow for daily science!
